description: This file defines the custom annotation @Verifies used for marking test methods linked to specific behaviors in the OpenMRS project. It includes metadata such as description and method name, and is marked as deprecated.

classes.name: @Verifies
classes.description: Custom Java annotation for linking test cases to specific behaviors, marked as deprecated, targeting methods, retained at runtime.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the description of what the test case is verifying, linked to '@should' annotations.

methods.name: method
methods.description: Returns the name of the method that the test case is testing.
